editorial_position: 从舞台、衣服和音乐，到树皮布、岛屿与城市，观察空间如何随着人的行动和关系变化。

art_direction.dominant_mood: 深蓝、暖白与琥珀色为舞台、材料和人的移动建立安静的阅读节奏。
art_direction.background_logic: 沿用已确认的共享空间浏览与默认环境色，阅读背景保持克制。
art_direction.palette_logic: 原创封面使用深蓝、暖白与琥珀；文章沿用共享阅读系统默认色板。
art_direction.type_scale_logic: 沿用共享阅读系统的中英文字级、行高与对齐。
art_direction.image_behavior: 官方来源图注明历史、海报与现场边界；权利不明的图像仅外链预览。
art_direction.page_density_and_tempo: 十篇按建筑、服装、音乐、城市、物件和收藏交错排列。
art_direction.core_visual_action: 从历史舞台图进入，再通过共享浏览结构切换文章。
art_direction.cover_composition: 原创几何轨迹与十个圆点呼应运动，不冒充纪实图像。
art_direction.desktop_interaction_mechanic: 复用已确认的空间浏览和整期定位。
art_direction.behance_viewing_arc: 从可移动的舞台到城市设想，沿着人的行动和物件的流转阅读。
art_direction.mobile_translation: 沿用手机自然滚动与共享阅读入口。
art_direction.mobbin_usability_constraint: 保持共享系统的键盘、无脚本、减弱动态和风格外观支持。
art_direction.quiet_ending: 结尾退入深蓝与暖白，沿用共享每日语录轮播。

closing_quotation.text: What remains after the spectacle is the method that carried it.

closing_palette.rationale: 深蓝与暖白保证正文对比；琥珀色呼应运动轨迹，与近期封面的三色组合区分。

repeated_mechanisms: approved shared B spatial browsing and whole-edition reading
official image links and local non-documentary fallbacks
variation_review.exception_reason: 复用已确认的共享阅读结构；已核对最近七期封面和结尾三色，本期以原创几何轨迹、选题及官方图像形成变化。

limitations: Non-production Preview only. External official images retain linked origins and owned non-documentary fallbacks; reproduction rights are not treated as cleared by the user instruction.
Research and content were prepared after the Production window; actual timestamps are retained and Production remains blocked.
Registry scans record real attempts, including access-limited and unresolved subjects; those states do not establish that there was no news.
